name: 滿版影片無文字＋右下資訊卡
desc: 背景為滿版影片，主視覺內不放標題，只在角落放一張橫式資訊卡和捲動提示，讓影片成為主角。
prompt: 背景為滿版影片，主視覺裡不放大標題或其他文字，畫面中央完全留給影片。
mobile: 仍撐滿一個畫面，高度要避免網址列伸縮造成跳動；背景影片改為直式裁切；捲動提示隱藏；右下角的資訊卡移到主視覺底部，橫跨接近整個畫面寬；沒有捲動效果。

en.name: Full-bleed video, no text, corner info card
en.desc: A full-bleed video background with no headline inside the hero; only a landscape info card and a scroll indicator sit in the corners, letting the video take center stage.
en.prompt: The background is a full-bleed video. No headline or any other text is placed in the hero; the center of the viewport is left entirely to the video.
en.mobile: Still fills one viewport; avoid height jumps caused by the mobile address bar resizing. The background video is cropped to portrait. The scroll indicator is hidden. The info card in the bottom-right corner moves to the bottom of the hero, spanning nearly the full viewport width. There is no scroll effect.

accessories.prompt: 在主視覺左下角放一個捲動提示：一顆小型圓形圖示按鈕，裡面是向下的箭頭。
accessories.mobile: 捲動提示在手機版隱藏。

en.prompt: Place a scroll indicator in the bottom-left corner of the hero: a small circular icon button containing a downward arrow.
en.mobile: The scroll indicator is hidden on mobile.

accessories.prompt: 在主視覺右下角放一張橫式資訊卡，約佔畫面寬的四分之一：左側是一張方形小縮圖，中間是小標籤和次要文字（可多行），右側是一顆圖示按鈕。
accessories.mobile: 資訊卡在手機版移到主視覺底部整列，橫跨接近整個畫面寬，內部結構不變。

en.prompt: Place a landscape info card in the bottom-right corner of the hero, about a quarter of the viewport width: a small square thumbnail on the left, a label and secondary text (may wrap to multiple lines) in the middle, and an icon button on the right.
en.mobile: On mobile the info card moves to a full-width row along the bottom of the hero, spanning nearly the full viewport width, with its internal structure unchanged.
